name: Minesweeper
author: PointNet Games
description: Minesweeper with dual modes (Classic and Scalata 18 levels), multi-language support (IT/EN), Educational Practice Mode (didactic replay on error, rule-based hint deduction, visual heatmap safety overlay, false flag detection, smart cell tutor inspector, tactical pattern recognizer 1-2-1, 1-2-2-1, 1-2-X, 1-1-X, and pattern reductions), Clean One aesthetics, smart chording, pan & pinch-to-zoom, and tactile sound.
instructions: Tap or click a cell to reveal it. Tap numbers with matching flags to chord. Drag to pan, pinch or use wheel to zoom. Toggle ⛏️/🚩 or right-click/long-press to place flags. Shortcuts: M = audio, Esc = exit fullscreen.
